blocks.text: The central narratives in Judges are guided by a programmatic pattern introduced in Judges 2, yet the individual episodes do not all repeat every stage in the same fixed sequence. This makes Samson’s story part of the book’s larger pattern without requiring Judges 15 to match a mechanical formula.

Samson is introduced as one who will begin delivering Israel from the Philistines; the narrative does not say that he completes that deliverance. Judges 15 therefore belongs within an unfinished Samson narrative rather than presenting a final resolution.
